scope: Original MetaRocq self-verification variation only; not the canonical Rust-native MetaRocq-rs MetaTheory
canonical_execution_chain: quote Original MetaRocq and its metatheory into a baked PCUIC snapshot
lower the quoted metatheory through a proof-producing HOL/OpenTheory IR
serialize an OpenTheory article using the verified reader command vocabulary
check the article with the Candle-based verified OpenTheory checker
extract the self-verifying MetaRocq runner to lambda-box
lower lambda-box to CakeML with pinned Peregrine
execute the CakeML program and replay the self-verification

trust_policy.external_scripts: bootstrap, invocation and evidence transport only; they do not select, synthesize, translate or accept proofs
trust_policy.candle_acceptance: an OpenTheory artifact is independently accepted only after the pinned verified reader successfully checks it
trust_policy.semantic_preservation: tool exit status alone is insufficient; each PCUIC-to-HOL/OpenTheory lowering rule must have an explicit correctness theorem or remain blocked
trust_policy.canonical_rust_metatheory: out of scope; only GPT-6 Astra may select the canonical Rust-native MetaRocq-rs MetaTheory

known_open_obligation.name: PCUIC proof derivation to HOL/OpenTheory derivation
known_open_obligation.policy: the executable architecture may be built around this boundary, but e2e verification may not be reported successful until this lowering is mechanically produced, independently checked by Candle, and justified by a semantics-preservation proof
